utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive—sorry, I must’ve missed the details. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ve been telling neighbors about the repair drive, and I’ll keep spreading the word. If you’re willing, just help point anyone interested my way.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that — if I hear anyone interested, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal—if you can send over the volunteer names, I’ll get the sign-out list started and check in with everyone. The drill and wrench set would help a lot too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll send over the volunteer names right away, and I’ll see about the drill and wrench set too. I’ll let you know as soon as I have both.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal—I appreciate it. Once you have the names and tools sorted, send them my way and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure thing — I can help with that and bring the broken lamps over by 5.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Jules — that helps a lot. Bring them by 5, and I’ll let you know the exact time once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll bring the lamps by 5 and keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane—basic tools, screws, nails, and any spare tarps or duct tape would help most. If you can drop them off sometime this week, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I can bring screws, nails, and some duct tape, and I’ll check for a spare tarp too. I’ll drop them off this week, probably around 6:30 again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be perfect, Dane—thanks so much. Around 6:30 works great.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a few tools and some spare nails, plus anyone who can help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right? I can swing by with whatever tools I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, it’s still happening. Thanks—bring whatever tools you can, and I’ll keep sorting out what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great to hear—looks like the repair drive is shaping up nicely. I’ll keep my ear out if anyone else has tools or a hand to offer.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess. I can bring my drill and a few screwdrivers if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be a big help, Gus—thank you. I’ll make sure folks know you’re bringing the drill and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — it’s this Saturday morning at the community center, and we’re mainly looking for help with small home repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll bring the drill and wrench set and send along the volunteer names. Saturday morning at the community center works for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thank you — the drill and wrench set will be perfect. Send the volunteer names when you can, and I’ll keep working around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll be ready at 6:30 with the screwdriver and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, but I still need the exact address and drop-off time before I can confirm. Could you send those again so I can plan around it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Of course — what’s the exact address and drop-off time again? I’ll make sure I’m there on time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Do you still need any tools or extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: After 3 still works for me, and I’ll be there. If you need the volunteers’ names, I can send them over when I have them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: After 3 works for me too—thanks, Uli. And yes, please send the volunteers’ names when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That still works for me — I can bring the drill on Saturday morning. If you still need a ladder, I’ll see what I can find before then.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thank you. I’ll check whether we still need the ladder and a few extra hands for sorting.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, just let me know if you need me to bring anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll send over the repair drive details and the school times next.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It starts at 10 Saturday morning by the community center—just bring any tools you’re willing to lend and maybe a pair of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass that along and send the repair drive details with the school times next.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we have any exact dates yet, or is it still up in the air?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s set for Sunday at the community center now. I can send around the details if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sunday works. Please send the details so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late again, but I can still help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — could you bring the screwdriver and gloves? That would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing — I’ve got the screwdriver covered, and I’ll grab some gloves too. I’ll be there soon.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — just confirming, the repair drive is still on with Opal, right?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s still on. Send me the addresses once you have them, and I’ll keep track of the homes that still need repairs.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks — just confirming, it’s still on and I should send you the addresses when I have them, right?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the date yet, Jules? I’d like to lock it in soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the final date, but I’ll let you know as soon as it’s confirmed. If it helps, I can also check in with the group again today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Jules. Please do check in with the group today—I’d really like to get it locked in soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—thanks, Leo. Could you send the volunteer names and let me know when you can stop by?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll send over the volunteer names and stop by times now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thank you, Leo — I’ll keep an eye out for them and coordinate once they come in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I can spread the word for tools, nails, and anyone who can help sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can you send me the exact drop-off time and address again? I just want to make sure I don’t miss it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I don’t have the exact details in front of me, but I can ask for them and send them over as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: After 3 is perfect — just come by the community center then. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I’ll swing by after 3 and drop off whatever supplies you send over. Thanks!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll send the list over shortly—really appreciate it, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — just checking, it’s this Saturday morning at the community center, and you need help with things like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves, right?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, that’s right — I can bring a basic tool kit and a few extra screws if that helps. Just let me know what’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would help, thanks — if you could focus on the leaky faucets first, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s still set for this Saturday morning at the community center, with small repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that sounds doable. I’ll check our supplies and see if we still need any tools, nails, or extra hands to sort donations.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Cleo—that would be a big help. Let me know if you need me to coordinate any extra hands or work around any school times.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Rosa—sounds like the repair drive’s really coming together. If anyone else has tools or supplies to spare, send them my way and I’ll pass it on.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — I’ll send anyone with extra tools or supplies your way. And just a reminder, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks for the update—I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center. If anyone else’s got tools or supplies, I’ll send them your way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren—basic tools, screws, nails, and any spare tarps or duct tape would help most. If you can drop them off sometime this week, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—I can drop off some tools, screws, and a tarp this week. I’ll swing by before Saturday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That works great, Oren—thanks so much. I’ll be around before Saturday, and we really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s this Saturday morning at the community center—small repairs like leaky faucets, loose cabinets, and broken shelves. If you want, I can send the address and exact meet-up time too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, that helps. Send me the address and exact meet-up time, and I can see if I’m able to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the address and exact meet-up time right away, and I’d love to have you there if you can make it.
